_about: Public-domain C. J. Vaughan (Charles John Vaughan, 1816-1897, Head Master of Harrow, Master of the Temple, Dean of Llandaff) for the Word Hoard: Prospects of the Church of England (1868) and The Book of Light in the Hand of Love (1872) from Project Gutenberg, and 33 books from Internet Archive scans, 1853-1893: his Greek Romans (1859), lectures on Philippians, Revelation and Acts (The Church of the First Days, three series), and sermons from Harrow, Doncaster, the Temple and the universities. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 23 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
